title: Results submitted by a solver's developer or user
description: submissions/<slug>/submission.json: who ran which solver, on which cases, with which results files. The suite scores the files itself (scripts/score_submissions.py); a submission never carries its own pass/fail.

options.description: Solver options used for every case unless a case says otherwise (scheme, wet/dry depth, time-step control).

submitted_by.description: Organisation that ran the solver. Shown on the site.

results_licence.description: Licence under which the results files and score cards are published.

case_version.description: The case version the run used; a submission for an older version is not scored.

results.description: Results files (Parquet or CSV in the results contract), relative to the submission folder. For cases with grid refinement, one file per level; the finest is scored and all are used for the convergence check.
